classification.difficultyReason: Infer the square diagonal from the cylinder diameter, obtain an exact side length and combine prism and cylinder volumes.

content.prompt:
A concrete support column is made up of a cylindrical base and a square prism.
The cylindrical base is 1 m in diameter and 1 m high,
and the square prism is 10 m long and sits on the cylindrical base.

spec.description: Square prism seated on a cylinder, with its square base inscribed in the cylinder top. Visible front square sides carry equal-length ticks. Hidden rear edges and arcs are dashed; upper prism edges end in dashed continuation strokes. Source outline and hidden-edge hues are replaced by ordinary black with dash distinctions.
spec.mathematics: Cylinder diameter 1 m and height 1 m; square-prism length 10 m. The inscribed square diagonal equals the cylinder diameter.
spec.answerVisibility: No side length, square area or calculated volume is shown.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the exact side length of the square base of the prism.

answer.worked:
The square is inscribed in the circle, so its diagonal is the 1 m diameter. Let its side length be $s$.
$$\begin{align*}s^2+s^2&=1^2\\s^2&=\frac12\\s&=\sqrt{\frac12}=\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence show that the volume is approximately $5.8\text{ m}^3$.
